subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: Should Reef Doctor treat valid legacy state above these hard caps as an archive-for-manual-recovery case, rather than importing it automatically or offering a supported streamed recovery path?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive persistent-state behavior change: the selected limits determine when existing user state stops migrating automatically and instead requires operator action.

options.title: Confirm caps and prove recovery
options.body: Keep the proposed limits, add redacted end-to-end Doctor evidence for normal and oversized inputs, and document the supported manual-recovery result before merge.

options.title: Design a streamed migration path
options.body: Replace archive-only handling with a bounded incremental importer if maintainers require automatic migration of valid large legacy state.

recommendation.title: Confirm caps and prove recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed limits, add redacted end-to-end Doctor evidence for normal and oversized inputs, and document the supported manual-recovery result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current implementation and can provide the requested end-to-end evidence while an area owner decides the retained-state policy.
